Accepting records your approval and lets this proposal become authoritative state — an expense with its own allocation to decide, or a settlement discharging a debt. The payment amount and narration are unchanged either way.

Approve this distribution
This writes a new allocation version with the lines above, superseding the current one, and the obligations between people change accordingly. Already-recorded settlements are untouched — if a refund leaves someone overpaid, that shows up as a balance running the other way rather than as a settlement being rewritten.
